$typeAliasSpellingComment: D-FFI-DESCRIPTOR-TYPE-ALIAS-SPELLING-KEYED-ON-DATA-MODEL-ALONE (P48 lane st, 2026-09-01): `size_t`'s variant selector was `when:{dataModel}` ALONE, on a TWO-WORLD assumption (LP64 spells it `unsigned long`, LLP64 `unsigned long long`) with a THIRD world under it. Darwin is LP64 and spells `uint64_t` `unsigned long long` while keeping `size_t` `unsigned long`, so one `dataModel` axis cannot express the group and Darwin recorded a false ABI spelling for the aliases that DO move. Every arm now names BOTH axes, `when:{dataModel,format}` - `format` is DSS's per-OS axis, and `sys/types.json` already keys `off_t` this way. The full per-type per-platform measurement lives ONCE in `stdint.json`'s `$comment`. MEASURED for `size_t` (`_Generic` compile-only probe, Apple clang 21 on macOS 26.6.2 both arches, WSL gcc 13.3.0 + clang 18.1.3, mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 + MSVC 19.51.36252): `unsigned long` on elf AND macho, `unsigned long long` on pe - so no VALUE moved in this file, only the KEY that selects it, and the `strlcpy`/`strlcat` u64 returns this file pins are untouched. `dataModel` stays in the conjunction so a future ILP32 target matches 0 arms and fails LOUD (D-FFI-STDINT-PTR-WIDTH-ILP32, still open) instead of binding an 8-byte `unsigned long` where the platform's is 4.
$comment: ★ TF-C111 (D-FFI-PE-CRT-UCRT-MIGRATION P3): `library.pe` is now ucrtbase.dll. This file moved with the whole co-state group (malloc/stdlib/string/stdio/io/errno/direct/process/sys-stat in ONE commit) for exactly ONE row's sake — `_strdup` RETURNS a CRT-heap pointer the caller later hands to `free`, so it must name the same runtime as malloc.json/stdlib.json or the free walks a foreign heap, silently. Every other row here is a pure value->value byte mover over caller-owned buffers and would have been safe to leave; half-moving a descriptor is the same hazard as half-moving the group, so it moved whole. All 19 pe-effective symbols re-MEASURED as ucrtbase exports at TF-C111 (`objdump -p`); no renames were needed. | ★ c82 (shell.c): `typedefs`/`constants` re-provide size_t + NULL — C89 7.21.1 REQUIRES string.h to provide both without stddef.h; widths/values identical to stddef.json, first-wins dedup makes the multi-header provision moot (stdio/stdlib/time re-provide too, exactly like real libc headers). strdup is POSIX (C23 adopted it) → per-symbol [elf,macho]; the msvcrt spelling is _strdup (the plain-name legacy alias is unverified) — ungate when a pe consumer verifies it. ★ TF-C49 (SQLITE_THREADSAFE=0): `strerror` is C89 7.11.6.2 (`char *strerror(int)`) exported by libc on ALL formats (glibc/msvcrt/libSystem `T`) → NO format gate. SQLite's unixLogErrorAtLine takes the `#else` (non-threadsafe) branch `zErr = strerror(iErrno)` when SQLITE_THREADSAFE=0 (the default THREADSAFE build takes the `zErr = ""` branch → references NEITHER strerror nor strerror_r, why the default corpus compiled clean without it). strerror_r stays UN-shipped: its `#if SQLITE_THREADSAFE && defined(HAVE_STRERROR_R)` branch needs HAVE_STRERROR_R, an autoconf probe DSS never defines → no consumer (would be a speculative build). ★ D-CSUBSET-DARWIN-BSD-SYMBOL-CLUSTER: strlcpy + strlcat — the BSD bounded copy/concat pair, SDK _string.h:201-202 `size_t strlcpy(char *dst, const char *src, size_t size)` (strlcat same shape), exported by libSystem (link-verified on this machine). Per-symbol [macho] by the no-over-ship rule: every measured consumer lives in sqlite os_unix.c's `#if defined(__APPLE__) && SQLITE_ENABLE_LOCKING_STYLE` proxy/AFP-locking region — strlcpy ×7 (first: proxyGetLockPath os_unix.c:7434) + strlcat ×2 (os_unix.c:7443) — and glibc only gained the pair in 2.38, so an elf arm would also be an unconsumed portability claim (the strdup gate's inverse). The descriptor SHADOWS the real _string.h totally (angle-include never reads the SDK text), so each name is S0001 without its row. RETURN is the BSD semantics — the length of the string it TRIED to create (strlen(src); resp. initial dst length + strlen(src)) — NOT the dest pointer like strcpy/strcat; the u64 result is load-bearing and pinned by tests/ffi RealStringJsonStrlcpyStrlcatMachoOnly + the shipped_strlcpy_strlcat_macho corpus exit arithmetic (5*8+2=42 folds only if both returns cross the FFI correctly).
